name: Aumnis
bio: Falrae's tutor, Aumnis has the sacred task of guiding the Wanewood's nigh-immortal spirits onto their next phase of life. It's her arrows that guide the Ancients on their path into the great unknown, where they are said to start their cycle anew. Aumnis has been doing this sacred duty for so long, it might be her time to go soon...
